chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him):
He said: The sunnah is to carry the bier from its four sides; whatever carrying is done beyond that is voluntary (tatauwwu').

key_terms.السَّرِيرَ: the bier — the funeral stretcher or bed on which the deceased is carried
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the sunnah — the established, recommended practice transmitted from the Prophet and Imams
key_terms.تَطَوُّعٌ: tatauwwu' — a voluntary supererogatory act performed beyond the sunnah minimum
key_terms.جَوَانِبِهِ الْأَرْبَعِ: its four sides — technical term for carrying the bier from each of its four corners/sides (tarbi')

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah method for carrying a funeral bier according to Imam al-Baqir (AS) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) defines the sunnah method for carrying the funeral bier: it must be lifted from all four sides, a practice technically termed tarbi' al-janazah. Any additional carrying beyond this prescribed minimum is meritorious but classified as tatauwwu' (supererogatory), distinguishing the obligatory sunnah from optional extra acts.
